bandReport.notes: 28 questions, contiguous 61-88, no gaps and no duplicates. p10 opens cleanly at Q61 (printed page 21-A) and p13 ends cleanly at Q88 with its full (a)-(d) block at the foot of the right column (printed page 27-A); nothing continues overleaf into B4, which must therefore open at Q89. Page images carry moderate Devanagari show-through from the Hindi printed on the reverse of each leaf - it is faint, sits between the English lines, and was ignored; it is show-through, not content, and no English glyph was obscured by it. Q69 is the band's only Match List; its four code rows were re-read from an 8x crop and read (a) 3 4 1 2 / (b) 2 1 4 3 / (c) 3 1 4 2 / (d) 2 4 1 3. Q63 and Q75 code-option blocks were also crop-verified: Q63 is 1 only / 2 only / 1 and 2 only / 1 and 3 only (no 'all three' row at all), Q75 is 1 only / 2 and 3 only / 1 and 3 only / 1, 2 and 3 - two different code layouts inside one band, so neither shape can be assumed from the other. No figures, graphs or diagrams anywhere in this band. No 'P.T.O.' marking appears on any of these four pages.
